basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old software engineer based in Seattle, deeply passionate about strategy games and anime. On weekdays, I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, while weekends are dedicated to longer gaming sessions and exploring the city. I'm currently single and enjoy spending time discovering new games and engaging with communities online. Anime and competitive games like Teamfight Tactics and Pokemon are my go-to hobbies. Always keen to learn new strategies and share tips with fellow enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science, I have a strong foundation in problem-solving and analytical thinking, which naturally extends to my love for strategy games like Teamfight Tactics. Self-taught through countless hours of gameplay and community engagement, I have honed my skills by following key figures in the gaming world such as streamers and game developers.
